read.summary: Power bank melted and the casing burned while charging on a desk.

signal.rule: Early warning: two or more independent first-hand reports of a serious hazard, or one whose photo shows fire, heat or swelling damage. Same person, same photo or copied words count once.
signal.status: early warning: sent for review by a person (not a recall)

next: Thank you. If it hurt someone or caught fire, also report it to your regulator: POST /v1/after-purchase drafts that complaint for you.
label: Gemini read the report; code decides when reports add up to an early warning. Not a recall.
